description: This file defines the ZoomControl class, which provides a GUI component for zooming in and out, including buttons, keyboard shortcuts, and zoom level management.

classes.name: ZoomControl
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that manages zoom level controls with buttons and keyboard shortcuts, and communicates zoom level changes via a listener.

methods.name: ZoomControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the zoom control panel with buttons, tooltips, and key bindings.

methods.name: getZoomProvider
methods.description: Returns an instance of ZoomProvider that provides the current zoom value.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Binds keyboard shortcuts to zoom in and zoom out actions.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the zoom value, updates the UI state, and notifies the listener if present.
